Conditional Logistic Regression with KL Integration and a Ridge Penalty

ncckl_ridge.Rd

Fits the 1:m matched case-control model of ncckl with a ridge (L2) penalty on the coefficients, over a path of penalty values. The conditional likelihood is computed as a stratified Cox partial likelihood with every row of a matched set at the same time and Breslow risk sets, so the risk set of the case is its whole matched set whatever the row order.

Usage

ncckl_ridge(
  y,
  z,
  stratum,
  RS = NULL,
  beta = NULL,
  eta = NULL,
  lambda = NULL,
  nlambda = 100,
  penalty.factor = 0.999,
  standardize = TRUE,
  tol = 1e-04,
  Mstop = 50,
  message = FALSE,
  beta_initial = NULL
)

Arguments

y

Numeric 0/1 case indicator.

z

Numeric covariate matrix.

stratum

Matched-set identifier (required).

RS

Optional external risk score, one per row.

beta

Optional external coefficients (named vectors are aligned by name, see align_beta).

eta

Single non-negative integration weight.

lambda

Optional ridge penalty values; NULL generates a path ending at 0.

nlambda, penalty.factor, standardize, tol, Mstop, message, beta_initial

As in coxkl_ridge.

Value

An object of class c("ncckl_ridge", "coxkl_ridge").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(ExampleData_cc_highdim)
d <- ExampleData_cc_highdim$train
fit <- ncckl_ridge(y = d$y, z = d$z, stratum = d$stratum,
                   beta = ExampleData_cc_highdim$beta_external, eta = 1)
} # }
